One bounded option keeps the catalog function head and changes the query output to 16 independent sigmoid function scores. Train on external TRAIN desired-product multi-hot targets, keep explicit avoidance supervision separate, and apply deterministic eligibility masks before selection.

Zero grades mean unrequested for this explicit synthetic case, not a universal incompatibility claim. Use explicit avoided items as hard negative supervision; review weighting of other functions before dense BCE.
